Title: Chores for 7-Year-Olds: 3 Jobs They Can Own
Description: Three chores a 7-year-old can own: pull up the covers and put the pillow back, put their plate and cup by the sink after dinner, and put clean clothes in their drawers on laundry day. Each job has a clear when, so your child can tick it off on a free printable chart without asking you.
Keywords: chores for 7 year olds, chores for kids by age, responsibility chart for kids, age appropriate chores

Title: Family Laundry Schedule: Wash, Dry, Fold and Put Away
Description: Give laundry a regular day and one owner who takes each load from the washer all the way to the drawer. Kids can own a stage too, from matching socks and sorting lights and darks to folding and putting away their own clothes.
Keywords: laundry schedule for busy families, family laundry routine, laundry day schedule, kids laundry chores
